Protein Food

Ground Veal

About This Entry

Ground veal is minced veal trim used in meatballs, ragù blends, and terrines. Mild flavor blends with pork and beef in mixed grinds — pairs with Italian whites and everyday medium reds.

Beginner Guide

Often mixed with pork and beef for meatloaf and meatballs. Lean on its own — add fat or binders for juicy results.

FAQ

What is Ground Veal?
Often mixed with pork and beef for meatloaf and meatballs.
How should Ground Veal be cooked for best results?
Match cooking method to cut — quick heat for tender muscles, slow moist heat for collagen-rich cuts. Rest roasts before slicing.
